world.title: US President Donald Trump REACTS to Prince Harry and Meghan Markle’s UK move; says, ‘I wouldn't have taken them back'
world.summary: US President Donald Trump commented on Prince Harry and Meghan Markle's return to the UK, stating he would not have welcomed them back. He criticized their treatment of the royal family, reflecting on their six-year absence. The couple recently arrived in Birmingham with their children, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet, marking a significant moment in their public lives.

world.title: Mamdani imposes one-year ban on AI for most NYC students
world.summary: New York City officials have implemented a one-year ban on the use of artificial intelligence by students in public elementary and middle schools. This decision aims to establish guidelines for integrating new technology into the classroom. The moratorium reflects ongoing efforts by public officials to address the implications of AI in education and ensure appropriate usage among students.

world.title: 2 killed, multiple injured in Minneapolis apartment shooting
world.summary: At least two people were killed and six others injured in a shooting at an apartment building in downtown Minneapolis. The incident occurred around 5:45 PM local time, according to officials. Emergency services responded to the scene, and investigations are ongoing to determine the circumstances surrounding the shooting. No further details about the victims or suspects have been released.

business.title: Google’s Gemini 3.8 Flash is built for agents, while its Cyber twin hunts vulnerabilities
business.summary: Google has introduced two versions of its 3.8 Flash model, including a standard Flash designed for agentic tasks and a Flash Cyber variant focused on vulnerability detection and patching. The Flash Cyber model is noted for its efficiency, outperforming larger models while maintaining lower costs, making it particularly beneficial for cybersecurity teams in their efforts to enhance security measures.

business.title: Bata bids farewell to agency retainers after handing creatives to AI
business.summary: Bata has overhauled its marketing strategy by replacing traditional agency retainers with autonomous AI agents. These AI systems manage various tasks, including campaign creation, consumer engagement, and performance analysis. This shift reflects a growing trend among marketers to utilize AI for more comprehensive roles, moving beyond isolated assignments to fully integrate AI into their creative processes and operations.

technology.title: Dell's Product Portfolio Is Turning Into an AI Flywheel
technology.summary: Dell is evolving its product portfolio to leverage artificial intelligence, creating a synergistic effect known as an AI flywheel. This strategy aims to enhance its offerings for both investment professionals and individual investors. The company markets various products and services through license agreements and subscriptions, with a focus on generating revenue from its investment management business.

technology.title: URBN Launches 25,000mAh Power Bank with 100W Fast Charging Support
technology.summary: URBN has introduced the Mega Stack 25,000mAh power bank, featuring 100W fast charging capability. It includes three output ports and a smart display, making it suitable for charging smartphones, tablets, laptops, and consoles. This power bank is designed for users who require reliable charging solutions while on the go, ensuring efficient power delivery for multiple devices.

sports.title: 11 coaches reset in last five years and still searching for answers: Inside Pakistan cricket’s never-ending coaching carousel
sports.summary: Pakistan cricket has experienced frequent coaching changes over the past five years, with 11 coaches replaced amid disappointing performances in series and tournaments. This cycle of management reshuffles often occurs after poor results, leading to a new coaching regime before the previous one has had sufficient time to implement changes. The pattern continues, reflecting ongoing challenges within the team.

sports.title: The Winners and Losers of 2026 Summer Transfer Window
sports.summary: The 2026 summer transfer window saw significant activity among Europe's top clubs and players, with many making headlines. However, not all teams and athletes secured the desired deals before the deadline. Premier League clubs were particularly prominent, but the outcomes varied, leaving some clubs and players in advantageous positions while others faced disappointment as the window closed.

sports.title: Towhid Hridoy creates history with 350* in Bangladesh A game
sports.summary: Towhid Hridoy made history by scoring an unbeaten 350 runs off 481 balls in a match against South Africa A, becoming the first Bangladeshi batter to achieve this milestone in first-class cricket. His innings included 27 fours and 10 sixes. Hridoy previously contributed to Bangladesh's Under-19 World Cup victory six and a half years ago.

health.title: Wearable ECG monitor boosts arrhythmia detection after syncope
health.summary: The ASPIRED trial found that 14-day ECG monitoring after emergency department assessment for unexplained syncope did not reduce self-reported recurrent episodes at one year compared to standard care. However, the use of a wearable patch significantly increased the detection of serious arrhythmias, resulting in more patients receiving treatment. Additionally, mortality rates at one year were lower than with standard care.

health.title: Biting down on a stick
health.summary: Kate Clancy, author of "Pregnancy Interrupted," explores pregnancy loss and its realities, contrasting them with medical industry assurances. In June, US Representative Marie Gluesenkamp Perez revealed her recent miscarriage and described her experience with misoprostol, a medication used to expel pregnancy tissue. Clancy's work aims to shed light on the emotional and scientific aspects of pregnancy loss.

health.title: 24 scrub typhus cases reported in Shimla in ongoing Monsoon season; Health Department issues advisory
health.summary: Shimla has reported 24 confirmed cases of scrub typhus during the current monsoon season. The Chief Medical Officer, Yash Pal Ranta, has issued an advisory urging residents to remain vigilant against the disease, which is transmitted through bites from infected larval mites. These mites are commonly found in areas with bushes, grass, fields, and dense vegetation.

science.title: SpaceX sends $4.3 billion Roman Space Telescope to look for 'weird, rare, unusual’ stars and planets; leaves NASA's director Nicky Fox in tears
science.summary: SpaceX successfully launched NASA's $4.3 billion Roman Space Telescope aboard a Falcon Heavy rocket from Cape Canaveral, Florida, on August 30, 2026. The telescope will embark on a three-month journey to observe unusual stars and planets. NASA's director, Nicky Fox, was emotionally moved by the launch, marking a significant milestone in astronomical research and exploration.

science.title: A Giant Hexagon Has Been Spinning at Saturn’s North Pole for Decades. Now, Scientists Found Its Twin
science.summary: NASA's Voyager spacecraft discovered a giant hexagonal storm at Saturn's north pole in 1980. Recent Hubble images have revealed a similar decagonal-shaped wave around Saturn's south pole. This new formation adds to the understanding of Saturn's atmospheric phenomena, showcasing the planet's unique weather patterns. The hexagon has remained stable for decades, intriguing scientists studying planetary atmospheres.

science.title: Night sky events NASA says to watch this September
science.summary: NASA has announced several notable night sky events for September, including Venus reaching peak brightness, the fall equinox, and the Harvest Moon. These occurrences provide opportunities for skywatchers to observe celestial phenomena. The month promises a variety of interesting events, making it an exciting time for those interested in astronomy and the beauty of the night sky.

entertainment.title: US President Donald Trump REACTS to Prince Harry and Meghan Markle’s UK move; says, ‘I wouldn't have taken them back'
entertainment.summary: US President Donald Trump commented on Prince Harry and Meghan Markle's recent return to the UK, stating he would not have welcomed them back. He criticized their treatment of the royal family, reflecting on their six-year absence. The couple arrived in Birmingham with their children, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet, marking their official return to the UK.

entertainment.title: Aries Horoscope Today: September 3, 2026
entertainment.summary: On September 3, 2026, Aries is encouraged to step back and observe their surroundings. The focus is on the wharves, masts, and ships in the harbor, emphasizing the importance of scenic views and interconnectedness. This moment of reflection aims to help Aries gain perspective on their current situation and recognize opportunities for growth and connection in their life.

entertainment.title: Pisces Horoscope Today: September 3, 2026
entertainment.summary: On September 3, 2026, Pisces individuals can expect a positive shift in their mindset. Doubts and hesitation that previously clouded their thoughts are dissipating, leading to increased self-assurance. This newfound confidence allows them to explore new opportunities and embrace a more optimistic outlook. Overall, the stars indicate a favorable period for personal growth and decision-making for Pisces.
